g.text: Total time over every instance of a category

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each instance counts in one category, whatever language its source was written in. A family’s line is its

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: virtual best: the fastest of its systems on each instance. Total time over all of a category’s instances: a run

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: that does not answer (out of time or memory, failed, a program the system cannot express, or not given) counts

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: as its time limit, a time under 0.2 s as 0.2 s.
